module_summary: Destination half of a clearable gray-code CDC FIFO: a reset-controller half sequences isolate/clear phases across domains, gating the FIFO read side's valid/ready while clearing its pointers.

anchors.name: dst_data_o
anchors.why: FIFO read data presented to destination-domain consumer.

anchors.name: dst_ready_i
anchors.why: Consumer ready, gated by isolate before reaching FIFO read side.

anchors.name: async_data_i
anchors.why: FIFO storage array contents from source domain, read by destination side.

anchors.name: async_wptr_i
anchors.why: Gray-coded write pointer from source domain, synchronized for valid.

anchors.name: async_rptr_o
anchors.why: Gray-coded read pointer returned to source domain.

anchors.name: dst_clear_i
anchors.why: Destination-side request to clear the CDC FIFO.

anchors.name: dst_isolate_req
anchors.why: Isolation from reset controller; masks valid and ready during clear.

anchors.name: dst_clear_req
anchors.why: Clear request from reset controller resetting FIFO read pointers.

anchors.name: dst_isolate_ack_q
anchors.why: One-cycle delayed acknowledge of isolate request.

anchors.name: dst_clear_ack_q
anchors.why: One-cycle delayed acknowledge of clear request.

anchors.name: dst_clear_pending_o
anchors.why: Reports clear sequence in progress (isolate active).

anchors.name: async_reset_req_o
anchors.why: 4-phase request sending clear phase to source side.

anchors.name: async_reset_req_i
anchors.why: 4-phase request receiving clear phase from source side.

anchors.name: async_reset_next_phase_o
anchors.why: Clear sequence phase sent to the source half.

anchors.name: dst_valid
anchors.why: Raw FIFO not-empty valid before isolation masking.

groups.name: fifo_read_side
groups.description: Synchronizes write pointer, reads async array and drives destination stream.

groups.name: clear_controller
groups.description: Sequences isolate/clear phases with the source half over async handshake.
